title: eval-toolkit RunManifest (v2)
description: Schema for run_dir/manifest.json. Produced by eval_toolkit.manifest.write_manifest. NeurIPS Reproducibility Checklist-aligned. v2 adds: captured_at (auto-populated ISO-8601 UTC); top-level data_revisions and metadata (replacing meta:/hf_*: prefixed extra_code_versions); tightened gpu_info typing (count: integer, memory_gb: number).

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at build_manifest() call time. Replaces meta:run_timestamp_utc abuse of extra_code_versions in v1 consumers.

dirty_flag.description: True iff the working tree had uncommitted changes at run time (NeurIPS clean-replay concern).

code_versions.description: {package_name: version_string} — at minimum eval_toolkit. Caller-declared key dependencies (e.g. transformers, torch, sklearn). For dataset / model revisions use data_revisions; for run-time metadata use metadata.

data_revisions.description: {logical_name: revision_string} for input dataset and model revisions. v2 addition (was crammed under extra_code_versions in v1). Recommended key prefixes: 'hf_dataset:<name>' and 'hf_model:<name>'.

metadata.description: {label_name: label_value} for caller-supplied run-time labels (cli_args, environment selectors, etc.). v2 addition (was crammed under extra_code_versions in v1).

seeds.description: {source: seed} for global / bootstrap / torch / dataloader RNGs.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical-JSON encoding of the eval config.

env.description: Environment fingerprint (python, platform, key dep versions).

gpu_info.description: {name, count, memory_gb} from nvidia-smi (empty dict if unavailable). v2 tightens count to integer and memory_gb to number.

versioned_objects.description: {name: version} for any Tier-2 implementation exposing a `version` attribute.

leakage_report.description: Serialized LeakageReport (or null if no leakage checks ran).

source_roles.description: Optional generic source-role metadata for data-quality and evidence audits. Recommended roles: train, calibration, locked_eval, external_diagnostic, excluded; custom roles are allowed.

guardrails.description: Optional predeclared guardrails for claim/evidence discipline.

prediction_artifacts.description: Optional references to retained prediction artifacts.
